_doc: Stage order and reference DAG of the 13.54 chain (DESIGN section 4). The authoritative definition of a stage is its stages/<group>/<id>/stage.json; the 'stages' list below is the SKELETON from DESIGN (inputs / outputs as artifact ids) used by runner/ffrun.py to plan before every stage.json exists and to cross-check them ('ffrun.py dag --compare-skeleton').

runtime_rewrites.why: Meta's ImageBind URL has been dead since 2026-11-12; the HF copy pinned at commit 40c7e2a has the same SHA-256 d6f6c22b...2157. Applied at run time to every stage (idempotent when the stage already patched it).

upload_vars_why: every line `os.environ['<VAR>'] = '<slug>'` (or os.environ.setdefault('<VAR>', '<slug>')) of these variables is replaced at run time by `pass  # [ff runner] upload disabled (output becomes an artifact): <original line>` and the variable is removed from the stage's environment, so no stage uploads to Kaggle; the stage's output becomes an artifact under FF_WORK/art instead (runner/RUNTIME_CHANGES.md)

pip.original: run the notebooks' own pip cells unchanged (needs Internet; pip resolves to the newest releases of unpinned packages)
pip.pinned: PIP_CONSTRAINT=docker/constraints-kaggle-v173.txt for every stage + the unpinned ImageBind git URL rewritten to the commit below
pip.skip: pip is replaced by a no-op shim (offline runs in an environment that already holds the pinned packages, e.g. the Docker image)

git_pins.why: the notebooks install ImageBind from main; the Docker image pins the main of 2026-11-05 (unverified: same as HEAD at each run date)

pip.pinned_scope_note: docker/constraints-kaggle-v173.txt holds the newest releases before 2026-11-05 = the November image family of the F / R / Evaluation / FVBIND runs (configs/env_per_stage.json family v173). The runner warns when FF_PIP=pinned is applied to a stage of another family; FF_PIP_SCOPE=v173 keeps 'original' for those stages
